verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Knowledge Graph says it continuously generates insights that highlight configuration changes alongside errors and anomalies. Database Observability mentions analyzing deployment impact. Both are scoped add-on features, and the pack shows no general-purpose release or change tracking. Missing for 10: deploy or release markers (such as annotations) overlaid on dashboards, CI/CD or deploy-event ingestion, explicit regression-to-release correlation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
